categories: 应用 / 网页设计,信息图 / 教育视觉,极简主义,肖像 / 自拍,图解 / 图表
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a clean desktop web app screenshot showing an AI image generation gallery interface for comparing portrait outputs.

Canvas: Wide horizontal browser-like screenshot, approximately 1200×410 px, white background with generous margins, minimal modern UI.

Top input area: Centered rounded prompt bar near the top, light gray outline, containing the exact prompt text: “A close-up portrait shot of a young south east asia woman with long red hair illuminated by”. At the far right inside the bar is a black circular submit button with a white upward arrow.

Navigation row: Beneath the prompt bar, aligned left, show exactly 5 navigation elements: 1 magnifying-glass search icon, 2 selected pill tab labeled “All”, 3 text tab labeled “Pins”, 4 text tab labeled “Published”, 5 text tab labeled “Unpublished”. Use dark gray text, with the selected “All” tab in a light gray rounded pill.

Gallery layout: Show exactly 4 image cards in one horizontal row, evenly spaced. Each card is a pale gray rounded rectangle background with a vertical portrait thumbnail centered inside it and a small white outline heart icon near the lower-right corner of the card.

Portrait thumbnails: Each thumbnail depicts a close-up portrait of a young Southeast Asian woman with long red hair, wearing a plain gray T-shirt, photographed from the shoulders up against a muted green-gray background. The lighting is moody and directional, with realistic skin texture, dark shadows under the chin and neck, and warm reddish highlights in the hair. The face in each thumbnail is obscured by a soft rectangular blur censor block in muted beige-gray tones.

Count and variation of the 4 portraits: 1 left card shows the woman slightly angled with hair falling over the left side and the head cropped near the top; 2 second card shows a straighter centered head-and-shoulders crop with red hair framing both sides; 3 third card shows the chin lifted and neck elongated, face turned slightly upward with red hair visible on the right; 4 fourth card shows the closest crop, head high in frame, red hair along both sides, with the darkest face blur rectangle.

Visual style: Minimal white UI, soft shadows or very subtle borders, rounded corners, neutral gray typography, realistic generated portrait thumbnails. Keep the interface uncluttered and preserve the exact visible text labels. Do not add logos, watermarks, extra buttons, or additional gallery items.\

prompt_en:
[Basic Specifications]
- Character promotion poster
- Vertical (9:16) unified key visual
- Composition intended for series development

[Character Design]
- Faithfully reflect the reference image design (hairstyle/face/outfit/motifs)
- Accurately reproduce distinctive elements for high recognizability

[Compositional Structure]
- Hierarchical structure with 'large top, small bottom'
- Upper half: Enlargement of symbolic elements (head/facial outline/mask/upper body silhouette)
- Lower half: Full-body character placement
- Stable standing pose or light movement

[Main Visual Design]
- Strong iconic giant silhouette at the top
- Focus on visual impact
- Convey the character's symbol at a glance

[Collage/Double Exposure]
- Multiple elements contained within the giant silhouette
- Layering scenes, symbolic motifs, and environments
- Building a narrative
- Integrating into mist, ink, or negative space

[World-Building Expression]
- Multiple scenes based on the character's worldview
- Placement of symbolic motifs
- Movement or staging of smaller characters
- Environmental details (nature/architecture/atmosphere)

[Layout (Left-Right Composition)]
- Complementary elements placed on the left and right
- Providing rhythm to the composition
- Creating narrative tension

[Gaze Direction Design]
- A single visual line flowing from top to bottom
- Upper giant silhouette -> internal collage -> lower full-body character
- Continuous visual guidance design

[Margins & Edge Treatment]
- Large use of negative space
- Edge effects: ink bleeding, soft blur, fragmentary decomposition

[Aesthetics & Concept]
- Reflecting Eastern aesthetics: negative space, presence, imperfection
- Coexistence of silence and tension

[Style & Tone]
- Unified visual appearance
- Refined expression
- Restrained tone, avoiding information overload

[Finish Quality]
- High depth of field expression
- Strong visual impact
- Emphasis on storytelling
- Completion level suitable for a poster series\

title: 零余额银行故事板
author: AIライフハック
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,电影感 / 电影剧照,摄影,角色
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a cinematic 2x2 storyboard collage for a short dramatic video titled Zero Balance Despair, showing one Japanese salaryman discovering he has no money and falling into despair.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, divided into exactly 4 equal panels with thin white gutters. Photorealistic, high-resolution, cinematic lighting, realistic Japanese urban bank environment. Keep the same main character, outfit, hairstyle, watch, and brown leather shoulder bag across all panels. The character’s face should be intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur/mosaic block in every panel for anonymity.

Main character: A young adult Japanese businessman, messy black hair, navy suit, white dress shirt, loosened navy tie, brown dress shoes, silver wristwatch, brown leather shoulder bag. He looks exhausted, panicked, and emotionally overwhelmed.

Panel count and contents: Use exactly 4 panels.
1. Top-left panel: Inside or beside a bank ATM booth. The ATM screen clearly displays a large red “0” on a pale blue screen, indicating a zero balance. The businessman stands close to the ATM, shoulders tense, looking devastated, with his leather bag strap over one shoulder.
2. Top-right panel: At a bank service counter. The businessman leans forward toward a female bank clerk in a navy uniform, gesturing desperately with both hands open. The bank interior is clean and modern, with a blue counter, glass partitions, small signage, and warm office lighting.
3. Bottom-left panel: Outside the bank entrance. A blue sign above the door reads BANK. The businessman stands on the sidewalk in front of the bank with both arms thrown upward in panic, tie loosened, jacket open, brown shoulder bag hanging at his side. Bright daylight, urban street details, bollards, paving stones, and greenery.
4. Bottom-right panel: In a quiet park. The businessman sits slumped on a wooden bench, head bowed, arms hanging down, defeated. His brown leather bag rests on the bench beside him. Include trees, dappled sunlight, green shrubs, and a calm background that contrasts with his despair.

Visual style: Photorealistic Japanese commercial-drama stills, consistent character continuity, natural depth of field, sharp clothing detail, realistic bank and park locations, vivid but believable colors, emotional storytelling. No cartoon style, no extra panels, no captions except the ATM “0” and the exterior bank sign.\

At the top center inside the head, place a glowing full moon behind a celestial Buddha-like figure seated above a grand heavenly palace complex with multiple tiered roofs. In the upper-middle right, show 4 traveling figures on a cliff path: a monkey warrior with a staff, a monk riding a white horse, a pig-faced companion, and a dark-robed companion. In the middle, depict 1 dramatic battle scene of the monkey warrior confronting a coiling dragon or serpent in swirling clouds. In the lower-right, place 1 illuminated temple shrine nestled in the mountains with a golden sacred statue visible inside. In the lower area, add 3 tiny pilgrims walking through the misty valley. Use atmospheric depth, elegant calligraphic brushwork, drifting fog, and a refined cinematic composition that feels painterly rather than digital. Add vertical Chinese calligraphy on the left reading 西游记, with smaller vertical side text and several seal-style stamps for an authentic poster design. Include another subtle vertical location inscription on the right cliff face. The mood is sacred, epic, ancient, mystical, and poetic, with premium concept-art polish and almost no generic AI look.\

prompt_en:
Create a square 1:1 comic-style meme infographic titled What is a World Model? in huge bold black lettering centered at the top on a white background. Below the title, draw a clean black-outlined 3-column by 3-row grid with an extra left label column, like a humorous taxonomy chart. Column headers across the top are exactly three: “Predicts”, “Simulates”, and “Breaks Your Brain”. Row labels down the left are exactly three: “Robots”, “Foundation Models”, and “Movie Night”. Use thick black grid lines, white cell backgrounds, and colorful hand-drawn cartoon illustrations with crisp outlines, resembling playful science/AI memes.

Cell 1, Robots × Predicts: title “DreamerV3”. Show a cute small robot sleeping on a blue pillow/blanket, with “Zzz” nearby and a thought bubble containing three small sequential robot/world prediction panels ending with a red flag.

Cell 2, Robots × Simulates: title “Tiny Sandbox”. Show a glass snow-globe terrarium on a wooden base with a tiny robot standing on grass beside a tree, clouds, birds, and a sun inside the dome.

Cell 3, Robots × Breaks Your Brain: title “Reward Goblin”. Show a small robot startled by a frantic green goblin chasing floating gold star rewards along a dotted path, with a red exclamation mark near the robot.

Cell 4, Foundation Models × Predicts: title “Autocomplete Earth”. Show a retro computer-like AI with a green smiling screen and robot arms hovering over a globe, with a thought bubble containing a weather icon, a newspaper labeled “NEWS”, and a smiling emoji.

Cell 5, Foundation Models × Simulates: title “Weather Wizard”. Show an old wizard in a blue robe and pointed hat casting spells over a world map or globe-like table, surrounded by weather icons: storm cloud with lightning, grey cloud, rain cloud, tornado, and bright sun, plus a small server rack at the side.

Cell 6, Foundation Models × Breaks Your Brain: title “Everything Machine”. Show a giant black top-hat-shaped machine labeled FM with a flexible hose/tube, generating many outputs: a cloud, purple DNA strand, red car, small robot, and a document page.

Cell 7, Movie Night × Predicts: title “The Truman Show”. Show a man standing inside a transparent dome on a circular stage with a suburban house, fence, grass, clouds, and city skyline inside, surrounded by multiple studio cameras and spotlights outside the dome.

Cell 8, Movie Night × Simulates: title “The Matrix”. Show a person seated in a futuristic chair wearing a black outfit, plugged into cables, against falling green code, flanked by one red pill and one blue pill. Keep the face simplified or obscured.

Cell 9, Movie Night × Breaks Your Brain: title “SimCity God Mode”. Show a giant hand descending from a cloud and placing or pinching a building above a miniature city with roads, houses, factories, smoke, small people looking up with “?!” speech bubbles, and a bright sky.

Constraints: include exactly 9 illustrated content cells, exactly 3 column headers, exactly 3 row labels, and exactly the cell titles listed above. Keep all typography bold, legible, black, and meme-like. Use a polished cartoon infographic style, not photorealistic. No watermark, no extra logos, no additional panels.\

Main layout: Place the full-body main character photo-cutout style figure in the center-right, outlined with a white sticker border and pink shadow. She is crouching, smiling toward the viewer, making a peace sign near her face, wearing a white short-sleeved embroidered blouse with small red flowers, a white pleated skirt, white socks, pink shoes, short light-blonde bob hair, and a pink flower hair accessory. Her companion dog lies at her feet in the lower center, a small white-and-brown spaniel-like dog wearing a pink harness or outfit. Title area: At top left, large hand-drawn Japanese title text 「ぽちいな」 with a paw-print mark, and a pink ribbon underneath reading “POCHIINA”. Add small flowers, stars, hearts, and a thin sketchy rectangular title frame.

Profile panels and text: Use exactly 12 distinct information panels around the central figure. 1) A species/origin note panel at upper left with Japanese labels for species and origin, describing her as a human who uses healing magic and a girl born from a flower-and-animal-loving family. 2) A STATUS panel on the left with exactly 7 stat rows and horizontal pink bars: HP 840, MP 620, Attack 420, Defense 380, Magic 760, Agility 720, Luck 890, each with a small icon. 3) A WEAPON panel below it showing a magical flower staff, labeled 「お花のステッキ」, with a small staff illustration. 4) A special move panel labeled 「必殺技」 describing “Happy Flower Shine,” a healing flower-light attack. 5) A companion panel at bottom left labeled 「相棒：わんこ」 describing the dog companion. 6) A circular inset illustration near the bottom center showing the girl standing with the dog in a pink magical flower field. 7) A speech bubble near the character’s head containing 「今日も一緒にたのしくいこっ！」. 8) A rarity card at the top right labeled “RARITY” with exactly 5 stars: four filled pink stars and one empty gray star. 9) A personality panel labeled 「性格」 with four short lines describing kindness, brightness, compassion, and healing aura. 10) A likes/dislikes panel with two columns: likes marked by a heart icon and dislikes marked by a blue cloud/rain icon. 11) A favorite-things panel labeled 「得意なこと」 listing four things such as healing injured people, cheering everyone up, nurturing flowers, and photographing with a peace sign. 12) A weakness and flavor-text area on the right, split into small note boxes labeled 「弱点」 and 「その他・フレーバーテキスト」, describing loneliness, over-kindness, public performance nervousness, always being with the dog, finding small flowers, and gently transforming the world with her smile.

Bottom details: Add a pink brush-stroke quote banner near the lower center reading 「一緒にいるだけで、しあわせになれるよっ！」. Along the bottom edge place exactly 5 small attribute icons with labels: healing, support, nature, animal, and light. At the bottom right place exactly 2 small Polaroid-style photo cards, one showing the girl posing and one showing the dog lying down, with tape and a pink flower decoration.

Visual style: Soft natural lighting, pastel pink highlights, sketchy brown outlines, delicate hand-lettered Japanese text, scrapbook collage, sticker borders, cozy magical-girl RPG profile-sheet design. Constraints: Use Japanese text for visible labels and quotes as specified; use English only for “POCHIINA,” “STATUS,” “WEAPON,” and “RARITY.” Maintain exactly 7 status rows, 5 rarity stars, 5 bottom attribute icons, 2 Polaroid cards, and 12 information panels.
